correctness.rationale: For four distinct real reports, enumerate all six weighted pair costs to obtain N/Z and prove OPT=min(a+b,a+c,b+c) by contiguous median clustering. A reflection reduction and five explicit algebraic positive expressions certify 2 OPT Z-N>0 for all positive gaps. The profile (a,b,c)=(1,1,L) produces ratio (12L+13)/(6L+14) increasing toward 2, proving sharpness and nonattainment. A standard-library rational-arithmetic program passed 32015 supplementary assertions.

value.rationale: For two facilities, four agents are the first size with two unselected agents in each sampled outcome; quantifying the associated sharp welfare loss is a natural smallest genuinely multi-unserved benchmark. The exact 2 versus global 4 bound, strict nonattainment and outlier construction show how the probability-cost tradeoff behaves and can support later n-dependent analyses. The result is not based solely on numerical correctness or novelty, and does not claim incentives beyond existing literature.
